---
title: "Open-Source Software"
---

My open-source R packages are meant to dismantle what I call the ["Continental Fallacy"](https://pinasr.r-universe.dev/articles/ArchipelagoEngine/rtl_impact.html) in Spatial Data Science - the systemic bias in global software where the sea is treated as an empty void than a medium of connectivity which **erases archipelagic life.**
